skill.summary: Generate audiobooks, podcasts, or educational audio content on demand. User provides an idea or topic, Claude AI writes a script, and ElevenLabs converts it to high-quality audio. Supports multiple formats (audiobook, podcast, educational), custom lengths, and voice effects. Use when asked to create audio content, make a podcast, generate an audiobook, or produce educational audio. Returns MP3 audio file via MEDIA token.
